title: Research: exclude P112 2,4,5^9 by D7 support saturation
body:
## Summary

Exclude the actual P112 TWOSIDE `(5,6)` profile `2,4,5^9` over every characteristic-zero field, for eleven independent pieces with code-intersection dimension at least five.

```text
support-34 contraction and singleton selection
  root-only edges fail the retained A5 incidence bound
  a D7 edge forces disjoint saturated supports 2,8,12^5
  five twelve-point supports are required; the sharp maximum is three
```

Adds only `research/p112-d7-saturation/`, containing the [proof](https://github.com/petalas/integer-mult-bounds/blob/47558b8d6e296b15496edd19dbf3fb0f5f9f6ed5/research/p112-d7-saturation/PROOF.md), pinned sources, full receipt, registered replay and controls. Commit `47558b8d6e296b15496edd19dbf3fb0f5f9f6ed5`; baseline `997e6a9ca7b4f95d50e366f61412fd640d72a88a`, priority revision 6. [Canonical investigation](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/3156#discussioncomment-18999970).

Credit DreamingOfClouds/PR3154 for TWOSIDE, the original filters and handoff; Nick Petalas/PR3164, PR3174 and PR3175 for the retained geometry, A5 incidence and quotient-selection lineage; and the E8/P112 decoder predecessors recorded in SOURCES.json. Frozen predecessors are unchanged. Development and local checks used substantial automated assistance.

## Evidence

- **Before:** the original strict filters retain this deficit-one profile in their 77-profile inventory; every six-piece support-cap sum is at least 58, above the old strict-below-53 certificate gate.
- **After:** the new saturation proof excludes it. All 3,309,747 full120 five-flats, 240 relevant frames and 756 saturated live supports are covered. The disjointness graph has 16,464 edges, 30,016 triangles and no four-clique; an explicit triangle proves the sharp maximum three.
- Registered Python 3.12 replay and fourteen behavioral groups pass, including a separate complete packing enumeration, planted four-set rejection and source/receipt mutants. Strict Ruff, warnings-as-errors compilation, Python 3.13 optimized read-only Git-free and final committed exports pass. All 17 committed package/input files and all 17 published Git blobs equal tested working bytes; the live PR head matches the checked commit.

```sh
uv run --python 3.12 --no-project python -W error -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p112-d7-saturation
```

The standard Weyl-chamber theorem remains an explicit dependency. Internal reviews are not independent human or proof-kernel review. No full C5, `C(P112)>=64`, supplier admission or new kappa is claimed; the selected frontier stays unchanged. Open next questions and implementation bounds are included.

## Merge danger

**Door:** two-way.

**Blast radius:** research.

One isolated opt-in package; shared verification code and selected-result files are unchanged.
